svg.title: AuthPolicy (Keycloak JWT) Complete Data Flow (DNS → TLS → JWT Token Acquisition → Token Validation → API Access)

g.text: (DNS → TLS → JWT Token Acquisition → Token Validation → API Access)
- Manages DNS records via Route53 API
- Payload: sub, iss, exp, aud, claims
• AWS Load Balancer: Outside OpenShift Cluster
• OIDC Portal: Gateway redirects to Keycloak
